_comment: Legacy seed labels for the road-damage benchmark. Images are NOT committed: see eval/README.md. The v3 taxonomy is pothole_cavity, failed_patch, surface_breakup, rut_or_depression, other_road_damage, not_reportable or unlabelled; this seed still uses legacy pothole/not_pothole until the owner re-labels each subtype. Only six photos were confirmed by the owner, all positive. Every negative is assistant-judged and UNVERIFIED, so this set cannot measure false-positive accuracy or act as a release gate. Disputed images remain excluded.

images.label: disputed
images.notes: Silt and erosion strip along the lane, no discrete cavity. DISPUTED: the detector accepts this 4/4 under both the old and the new prompt, describing a specific defect (t049s: a broken strip down the centre of the lane; t061s: a shallow depression near the bottom of frame). The not_pothole label here is the assistant's and was never reviewed. Until a human rules, this image is excluded from the false-positive rate rather than counted against the detector.
